subject: Finlytics POC: plan, success criteria & weekly status
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@finlytics.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@finlytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC: plan, success criteria & next steps

Hi Jamie / Alex —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap + proposed POC plan so we have a shared next steps list.

Call summary:
- Goal: validate Redwood Inference as the primary inference runtime for Finlytics feature extraction and low-latency scoring (latency SLOs and unit cost targets).
- Primary models: open-model family (quantized) + internal reranker for results prioritization.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm/edit):
1) End-to-end latency: 99th percentile < 120ms on your standard 512-token scoring workload.
2) Throughput: sustain 500 qps during peak synthetic load without error spike.
3) Output parity: model responses meet agreed benchmarks on the 50 test prompts in the shared eval set (>= 95% score vs current baseline).
4) Cost target: per-invocation token cost reduction >= 30% vs current infra.

POC scope & timeline (rough):
- Week 0 (this week): access + infra checklist, confirm success criteria, sign NDA if needed.
- Week 1: integration (API keys, VPC peering or VPN access, sample data push).
- Week 2: baseline runs + collect metrics.
- Week 3: optimizations (batching/quantization) and rerun.
- Week 4: wrap-up + scorecard + exec review.

Immediate asks for Finlytics:
- Confirm the success criteria above or provide edits by EOD next Wed (2026-06-10).
- Provide an account admin who can create a short-lived service token / grant access: recommended contact: Alex.
- Share the 50 test prompts + current baseline results (or a sample dataset).

Attachments: finlytics-poc-requirements.xlsx (please fill sections 2 & 3).

I'll loop in Logan (SE) and Marcus (solutions) to lead the tech kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
-----

From: Jamie Park <jamie@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: plan, success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks great. A couple quick items:
- We like the success criteria but would prefer 99th percentile latency < 140ms (our infra is a little heavier than the sample you used). Is that an OK upper bound for the POC?
- We can provide the 50 prompts and baseline by EOD Wed (2026-06-10). I will fill the access contact as Alex (cc'd).
- Attached: finlytics-poc-requirements.xlsx (filled initial fields).

Jamie Park
Head of ML | Finlytics
jamie@finlytics.com
Attachment: finlytics-poc-requirements.xlsx

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@finlytics.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@finlytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: plan, success criteria & next steps

Hi Jamie — thanks for the quick turnaround and for filling the sheet. 140ms is fine for the POC acceptance target; we'll treat 120ms as our optimization target and 140ms as the acceptance threshold.

Logan and Marcus — can you please pick up the tech kickoff items below and confirm owners/times?
- Access: coordinate with Alex for short-lived service token and, if needed, VPC peering details. (Owner: Logan)
- Baseline run: run your existing model(s) on Redwood with the 50 prompts (Owner: Marcus)
- Metrics capture: configure the tracing and cost dashboard (Redwood Console) to capture latency/throughput/cost. (Owner: Logan)

I've uploaded a mutual action plan to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinlyticsPOC

I'll schedule a technical kickoff for Thursday 2026-06-11.

Best,
Marissa

-----

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie@finlytics.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC - Tech kickoff notes & owner action items

Hi all — notes from the kickoff and immediate action items.

Quick tech notes:
- Recommended initial config: 2x A10G instances, model quantized to int8, batching target 8, kv-cache enabled.
- We'll run the baseline using the 50 prompts you provided and compare against your baseline metrics.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Alex (Finlytics): provide S3 share or sample dataset + service token for testing (ETA: 2026-06-12).
- Logan (SE, Redwood): set up test endpoint, enable tracing + cost dashboard, confirm VPC details if needed (ETA: 2026-06-12).
- Marcus (Solutions): run baseline evaluation and post results to Drive (ETA: 2026-06-16).
- Marissa: coordinate weekly sync and unblock procurement if needed.

Attachments: redwood-poc-playbook.pdf (POC checklist & test plan).

Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai

Subject: Finlytics POC - weekly status (quick nudge)

Hi Jamie / Alex — quick weekly check-in and a short checklist so we keep momentum:

Status checklist:
- Service token / access: pending (Alex)
- Sample dataset / 50 prompts: Alex to upload by EOD 2026-06-12 (pending)
- Test endpoint + tracing: in progress (Logan)
- Baseline run: scheduled for 2026-06-14 (Marcus)

Next steps requested from Finlytics:
1) Confirm access (service token or S3 share) by EOD 2026-06-12 so we can run baseline on Mon.
2) If procurement requires an MSA or short SOW before we ingest any sample data, please flag now and Marissa can loop in legal/procurement.

If I don't hear back by Monday morning I'll send a short calendar nudge — want to keep week 2 experiments on schedule.

Thanks —
Marissa
